WITH per_media_type AS (
  SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name,
         AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS overall_avg_rate
  FROM per_media_type
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT p.byte_rate, p.track_count, o.overall_avg_rate
  FROM per_media_type AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE p.byte_rate > o.overall_avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count,
       AVG(byte_rate - overall_avg_rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: A track with NULL Bytes contributes to the media type's track count but is ignored in its rate average; media types are grouped by name as requested. REAL casts make the divisions non-integer.
